moments.title: I'm A Celeb 2026: Jungle Calling!
moments.blurb: The 26th series of I'm A Celebrity... Get Me Out Of Here! officially launches on Monday 16 November, with Ant & Dec returning to host from Australia and a rumoured line-up generating buzz.

angles.name: Launch Countdown
angles.copy: Ten days until Ant & Dec unleash a fresh batch of celebs into the Australian jungle! Who are you hoping to see on I'm A Celebrity... Get Me Out Of Here! this year?

angles.name: Line-up Speculation
angles.copy: Rumours are swirling about the I'm A Celeb line-up, with our very own Joanna Page among the names! Could Nessa be swapping Barry Island for bushtucker trials?

moments.title: Strictly Week 7: Show Must Go On!
moments.blurb: Strictly Come Dancing continues this Saturday for Week 7, but Jaime Winstone will be missing the live show due to an abdominal injury.

angles.name: Injury Update
angles.copy: Wishing Jaime Winstone a speedy recovery! She'll be missing Strictly this weekend due to injury. Who are you backing to dazzle the judges in Week 7?

angles.name: Who Will Shine?
angles.copy: With one couple out, the pressure is on! Who will top the leaderboard in Week 7 of Strictly Come Dancing? Tune in Saturday night!

moments.title: Rugby: England vs Australia Showdown
moments.blurb: England takes on Australia at Twickenham this Sunday, 8 November, in a major Autumn Nations Championship fixture.

angles.name: Match Build-up
angles.copy: It's the big one! England face Australia at Twickenham this Sunday in the Autumn Nations Championship. Who's heading to HQ?

angles.name: Twickenham Buzz
angles.copy: Twickenham is set for a massive weekend as England clash with Australia. The atmosphere will be electric for this Autumn Nations Championship battle!

moments.title: Rugby: Wales vs All Blacks Anticipation
moments.blurb: Wales prepares to host the New Zealand All Blacks at Principality Stadium on Saturday 14 November, promising a thrilling Autumn Nations Championship encounter.

angles.name: Cardiff Countdown
angles.copy: Eight days until the Principality Stadium roars! Wales vs the All Blacks – a clash of titans you won't want to miss. Get ready!

angles.name: Welsh Pride
angles.copy: The countdown is on for Wales taking on the legendary All Blacks in Cardiff next Saturday. Who's got their tickets?

moments.title: Cardiff Christmas Market & Winter Wonderland Open
moments.blurb: Cardiff city centre will be aglow with festive cheer from Thursday 12 November, as the Christmas Market and Winter Wonderland open their doors.

angles.name: Festive Cardiff
angles.copy: Get ready for some festive magic! Cardiff Christmas Market and Winter Wonderland open next Thursday. Time to plan your visit!

angles.name: Winter Wonderland Fun
angles.copy: Ice skating, festive stalls, and mulled wine! Cardiff's Winter Wonderland and Christmas Market are nearly here to kick off the season. What's your favourite part?

moments.title: Exeter Cathedral Christmas Market Begins
moments.blurb: The enchanting Exeter Cathedral Christmas Market returns to Cathedral Green from Friday 13 November, offering a month of festive shopping and treats.

angles.name: Exeter Festive Opening
angles.copy: Exeter's most magical festive event is almost here! The Cathedral Christmas Market opens its doors next Friday. Get ready for local crafts and delicious food!

angles.name: Devon Delights
angles.copy: Stalls, mulled wine, and the stunning Cathedral backdrop! Who's excited for the Exeter Cathedral Christmas Market opening next week?

moments.title: London Christmas Lights Switch-ons Start
moments.blurb: London's iconic shopping streets begin their festive transformations next week, with Christmas light switch-on events across Oxford Street, Knightsbridge, Marylebone Village, and Covent Garden.

angles.name: London Lit Up
angles.copy: The capital is getting festive! London's Christmas lights switch-ons begin next week. Which display are you most excited to see?

angles.name: Oxford Street Sparkle
angles.copy: Oxford Street's Harry Potter-themed Christmas lights switch on Monday! Get ready for some serious magic in the West End.

moments.title: Gavin & Stacey Stars Reunite for 'The Baddies'
moments.blurb: Rob Brydon, Alison Steadman, and Sheridan Smith from Gavin & Stacey are reuniting for a new BBC Christmas special titled 'The Baddies', an animation based on a Julia Donaldson book.

angles.name: G&S Reunion Buzz
angles.copy: It's not a new Gavin & Stacey episode, but some of our favourite cast members (Rob Brydon, Alison Steadman, Sheridan Smith) are together again for a BBC Christmas special, 'The Baddies'!

angles.name: Familiar Voices
angles.copy: From Barry Island to 'The Baddies'! Rob Brydon, Alison Steadman & Sheridan Smith are lending their voices to a new festive animation. Who's excited to hear them?

moments.title: Happy 88th to P.J. Proby
moments.blurb: American singer and actor P.J. Proby, known for his powerful 1960s vocals and flamboyant style, celebrates his 88th birthday today.

angles.name: 60s Legend
angles.copy: Sending birthday wishes to the one and only P.J. Proby, turning 88 today! A true showman of the 60s. What's your favourite of his hits?

moments.title: Happy 76th to Chris Glen
moments.blurb: Scottish bassist Chris Glen, best known for his work with The Sensational Alex Harvey Band, marks his 76th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock Bassist Birthday
angles.copy: Rock on! Happy 76th birthday to Scottish bass legend Chris Glen of The Sensational Alex Harvey Band. What's your top SAHB track?

moments.title: Happy 62nd to Corey Glover
moments.blurb: Corey Glover, the powerful lead vocalist of Grammy-winning rock band Living Colour, celebrates his 62nd birthday today.

angles.name: Living Colour Vocals
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 62nd birthday to Living Colour frontman Corey Glover! His voice is unmistakable. What's your favourite Living Colour song?

moments.title: Happy 82nd to Sir Tim Rice
moments.blurb: Acclaimed English lyricist Sir Tim Rice, known for his collaborations on iconic musicals like 'Jesus Christ Superstar' and 'The Lion King', turns 82 on Tuesday.

angles.name: Musical Maestro
angles.copy: A true legend of stage and screen! Sir Tim Rice celebrates his 82nd birthday on Tuesday. Which of his famous lyrics is your favourite?

moments.title: Happy 56th to Warren G
moments.blurb: American rapper and producer Warren G, a pioneer of the G-funk sound known for his 1994 hit 'Regulate', celebrates his 56th birthday on Tuesday.

angles.name: G-Funk Icon
angles.copy: Turn up the volume! Happy 56th birthday to the one and only Warren G on Tuesday. 'Regulate' still sounds fresh today!

moments.title: Happy 48th to Eve
moments.blurb: Grammy-winning American rapper, singer, and actress Eve, known for hits like 'Let Me Blow Ya Mind', turns 48 on Tuesday.

angles.name: Hip-Hop Queen
angles.copy: Wishing a fierce 48th birthday to the incredible Eve on Tuesday! From Ruff Ryders to Hollywood, she's done it all. What's your favourite Eve track?

moments.title: UK Weather: Chilly & Damp Friday
moments.blurb: The UK is experiencing a chilly, gloomy, and damp Friday, with temperatures around average for November and potential for overnight frost in some areas.

angles.name: Friday Forecast
angles.copy: A chilly and damp start to the weekend across much of the UK today. Grab a hot cuppa and wrap up warm if you're heading out!

angles.name: Autumn Feels
angles.copy: Definitely feeling like November! Expect gloomy skies and some damp patches today, with temperatures staying fairly average for the season.
